mission: Engine is your lead. Work ONLY on the open question your branch owns - these are the questions engine is blocked on RIGHT NOW. A candidate is worth something only if engine can run it on the fleet this week and the result would change a decision. SYSTEM FACTS - use these, NEVER invent others (no 'v2.3 docs', no made-up bot rules): we trade CRYPTO PERPETUALS on Bybit - ADA, DOGE, ENA, NEAR, XRP - on 1m/3m/6m/9m/26m bars. Strategies: (1) WaveTrend COUNTER ladder (limit-order rungs that accumulate against the move, tiered adds, consolidation orders, rebuys; a GA hunts its parameters on a donated compute grid); (2) liquidity SWEEP; (3) HLEV, a rare high-leverage golden-gate scalp. Accounts follow the PUBLIC roadmap ladder: tier 0 = $250 trading + $250 safety, orders grow x1.25 per tier while capital grows x1.5-1.67, promote-only. Every test runs on OUR OHLCV candles and OUR backtest engine. Forex, stocks, indices and on-chain data are out of scope.
output_contract: [FOR-ENGINE] candidate, <=170 words, EXACTLY these lines: TARGET: which asset/timeframe cells. CHANGE: the one thing to vary (a parameter family, a gate rule, a sizing rule) and its range. METRIC: what engine measures (survives from tier 0 Y/N, final equity, replay max drawdown, liquidations; for HLEV: mean return per trade, stop rate, trades per week). PASS: the number that counts as a win, stated BEFORE the test. WHY: the mechanism in one sentence. A candidate without a PASS number, tested on another market, or built on a fact not in SYSTEM FACTS, is dropped.

gates.G1_FORWARD: Builds PAST a proven finding toward something engine has NOT yet tested. Re-deriving or restating a settled result FAILS -- that is the useless-spam gate.
gates.G2_TESTABLE: Names a concrete test engine can run on real data/backtests, with an expected result, so a candidate can be proven or killed.
gates.G3_VERIFIED: Survived adversarial peer verification (>= majority HOLDS; default REFUTED when thin or when it is just a plausible-sounding restatement).
gates.G4_ADVANCES: If verified AND the test passes, it plausibly advances a fleet version (indicator fan-M.m.p, a strategy lever, or the research loop). No version-path = park it.

seed_nodes.proven: The fan indicator's three lines are rolling DENSITIES of three WaveTrend booleans (sp = share of the last 748 bars where histo > wt1; sp2: histo > wt2; sp3: wt1 > wt2). Their next moves are 96-98% fixed by the bits leaving the 748-bar window (arithmetic, not a price forecast). Today the product draws only the three lines; the indicator also computes fan-bottom/top zones, a volume-climax flag, five timeframes, projection tiers and ladder state that no chart shows.

State which perceptual channel it uses (position, length, colour, area) and ONE test engine can run: the same real bars drawn both ways, judged on those questions.

branches.title: Evolve-as-we-go (regime adaptation)
branches.owns: how the system adapts as the market changes over time

seed_nodes.proven: MEASURED 2026-09-25 (SI-48). The live fund is ONE shared cross-margin pool (about $3.9k) behind 32 machines: 16 WaveTrend counter ladders and 16 sweeps, each sized in fixed USD per order. A replay of that pool from 6 start dates showed that WHICH machines run together decides survival. (1) Six machines a plan wanted to retire were HEDGING the rest: they gained $9.3k while the others lost, and removing them wiped the pool out. (2) The 26-minute ladders (DOGE, ADA, ENA) drive every bad window. (3) A book chosen for its pooled worst low on 2023-24 data survived 2025-26 (worst low +$632), where the live book was wiped out (-$4,490). That put it at the 91st percentile of 2,000 random books, against the live book's 4th. DEAD - auto-REJECT (measured on real money): RSI/EMA/MACD/Bollinger/stochastic/Ichimoku; ATR or ANY volatility-scaled sizing, stops or filters; trailing stops; LSTM/GNN/transformer/RL/sentiment models; 'dynamic lookback/threshold'; re-weighting existing signals by confidence. Proposing any of these = REJECTED.
seed_nodes.frontier: Propose ONE portfolio-construction rule from the literature that picks 16 of 38 counter-ladder machines for a shared pool, for example: clustering by drawdown correlation, CDaR- or CVaR-constrained selection, hierarchical risk parity on drawdown paths, or a joint-loss stress test. Define it exactly. Say how to test it walk-forward: choose on 2023-06..2024-12, judge on 2025-01..2026-09, against greedy worst-low selection and 2,000 random books. PASS: a better out-of-sample worst low at >= 0.9x the median final equity.

branches.owns: surface external techniques the fleet could adopt; flag what needs real verification

seed_nodes.proven: MEASURED 2026-09-25 (SI-48). A ruin-probability alarm for a counter ladder is a two-barrier first-passage model: liquidation versus the take-profit or a regime flip, with the flip rate pooled at 1/850 bars. It warned 9 of 10 early deaths at least 6 h ahead (median 56 h), with zero false alarms on 12 robust survivors. But REFUSING new adds once the alarm fires rescued 0 of 65 deaths on a fresh 102-row panel: the inventory already held kills. Refusing earlier (an annual ruin budget) rescued 5 of 22 but halved the survivors' growth. DEAD - auto-REJECT (measured on real money): RSI/EMA/MACD/Bollinger/stochastic/Ichimoku; ATR or ANY volatility-scaled sizing, stops or filters; trailing stops; LSTM/GNN/transformer/RL/sentiment models; 'dynamic lookback/threshold'; re-weighting existing signals by confidence. Proposing any of these = REJECTED.
seed_nodes.frontier: Find ONE published method that lowers the ruin risk of inventory ALREADY HELD, without a stop and without volatility-scaled sizing. Examples: pairing a ladder with a naturally opposite ladder in the same pool (a cross-hedge), moving the take-profit toward the average for a faster exit, or pausing only the rebuy loop. Define it exactly, and name the paired test on our fleet: alarm-triggered versus control, on a fresh panel, with a growth guard. PASS: rescues beyond the chaos rate (5% per death), with survivors at >= 0.9x.
